title: B4: bench.json hand-taken benchmark snapshot + `orchestrator bench set/show` + prior weight when the scorecard is cold
spec:
Why: the user wants artificialanalysis.ai/models as an input for "what to use for what". Scout T-0007: no public API; the site's Terms of Use forbid automated scraping or mining (confidence 0.85). So the input is a snapshot entered by a human or by the Planner reading the page interactively, with provenance, never a fetcher. Depends on B1–B3 merged into goal/T-0005.

What (≤4 files: orchestrator/bench.py (new), orchestrator/cli.py, orchestrator/scorecard.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py):
1. orchestrator/bench.py — file STATE/bench.json: {"source": "https://artificialanalysis.ai/models", "taken_at": ISO, "taken_by": str, "models": {"<model id>": {"intelligence": float|null, "coding": float|null, "speed_tps": float|null, "price_in": float|null, "price_out": float|null, "display_name": str|null}}}. `def load()`, `def set_model(model_id, taken_by, **metrics)` (validates keys, numbers only, updates taken_at), `def prior_weights(executors) -> dict[executor_id, float]`: for each executor, if its model has a coding value: weight = 0.5 + coding / max_coding_in_file (range 0.5–1.5); else 1.0. Never fetch anything over the network; the module must not import urllib/requests/httpx (test asserts this).
2. scorecard.scores(): when an executor has fewer than min_runs runs, use bench.prior_weights() for it instead of 1.0 (cold-start prior); once warm, live data wins.
3. cli.py: `orchestrator bench show` (table: model id, display name, coding, speed, price, taken_at) and `orchestrator bench set <model_id> --by <name> key=value ...` (e.g. coding=61.2 speed_tps=120 price_in=2.5). Print the file path after set.
4. tests: set two models, prior_weights ranks them 1.5 and ≥0.5 in order; scores() for a cold executor equals its prior weight; `import bench` source contains no network module names.
Seed the file with model ids only and null metrics for gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-sol, taken_by "seed", so `bench show` works before anyone enters numbers. Add a top comment in bench.py: "No scraper by design: artificialanalysis.ai Terms of Use forbid automated data mining (checked 2026-09-17). Numbers are entered by a human or a Planner reading the page interactively."

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit: "bench: hand-taken benchmark snapshot with provenance; cold-start prior for pick_executor; cli bench show/set" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 with the new bench tests
uv run orchestrator bench show lists the four seeded model ids
uv run orchestrator bench set gpt-5.6-luna --by test coding=50 then bench show reflects it and taken_at updates
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/bench.py, orchestrator/cli.py, orchestrator/scorecard.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py, .orchestrator/bench.json
